## Revision validation checkpoint

The survey authority is repository commit `fe62ecc69b901619b79eea7d54910f832e7d3937`. Object inspection found 3,264 tracked files. The local checkout remains at `6fb4d801c908a04aaddc48accdce2e1777b1d26e`. Project files remain unchanged.

Approved packages F01, F06, and F07 are excluded from the pending register. Rejected packages F02, F03, and F04 are excluded. Deferred package F05 remains on `biophilic-suicidal-cusimanse` and is excluded. Protected licenses, quotations, captures, frozen output, serialized fixtures, technical syntax, identifiers, and wording fixtures remain outside direct rewriting.

The target revision resolved the former create and transition help omission. Canonical help and generated CLI reference text now include `--detected-by`, `--caused-by`, and `--ref`. The remaining CLI discovery defect is narrower. `scripts/gen_cli_help.py` excludes every route whose group is `intercept`, so top-level help omits routed explain, review, verification, scan, workflow, identity, configuration, and enrichment families.

The pending register is limited to named files and supported behavior claims. It includes client documentation, shipped help, current-state internal documentation, ADR lifecycle, focused comments and docstrings, infrastructure runbooks, package license inclusion, and bounded provenance research. It excludes generic prose enforcement, broad comment cleanup, release-note cleanup without a supported defect, and an S3 correction without implementation evidence. The internal-records survey agent remains active. No project file changed.
